messages:
Maria (Support): FYI customer OptimaHealth can't accept a final invoice until their internal PO is issued. They asked if we can provide a proforma/stub invoice for procurement to approve. Case CS-9821.
Maria (Support): Email excerpt from Optima procurement: 'We cannot process invoices without a Purchase Order number. Please provide a proforma invoice addressed to OptimaHealth and include tax/VAT details for our PO request.'
Chris (Billing): We can generate a proforma (non-payable) doc. Finance needs: billing address, tax ID, expected amount, and SOW reference. Proforma won't create a ledger charge.
Julia (Sales): @Maria can you confirm contract start and committed spend? Sales notes SOW-2026-07 for annual commitment.
Maria (Support): Confirmed contract effective 2026-02-01. Committed MRR ~€3,800 (annual ~€45.6k). Customer sent their PO template but no PO number yet — procurement wants the proforma to attach.
Sam (Procurement): @Chris we can accept a proforma that lists 'Estimated invoice amount' but it must include: supplier legal name, remit address, TAX ID, invoice date, and SOW ref. Please use: 'Redwood Inference, Inc., 1234 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103', TAX ID: 94-1234567. Payment terms: Net 30. Line item: Hosted API subscription (SOW-2026-07).
Chris (Billing): I'll draft. Confirm whether to include VAT breakdown (customer is EU) and the email to send to.
Maria (Support): OptimaHealth is in Dublin, VAT number IE1234567A. They requested a line showing 0% VAT and the note 'reverse charge — customer liable' on the proforma.
Billing Bot: Generating proforma... ref PF-1904827200-OPTIMA. Note: proforma file is informational only. Use command: /billing send-proforma PF-1904827200-OPTIMA --email optima.procurement@optimahealth.ie
Chris (Billing): Sent proforma PDF to optima.procurement@optimahealth.ie. Set a billing hold in the system so no final invoice is issued until we receive a PO number. @Julia please confirm sales approves the hold.
Julia (Sales): Approved. I'll follow up with our procurement contact and ask them to include the PF ref and SOW number on the PO.
Maria (Support): Customer replied: 'We'll submit PO by EOD Friday. Please confirm you will not bill us before the PO is in place.'
Chris (Billing): Confirmed — billing hold active. We will not issue a final invoice until we receive an official PO number. If PO collection extends beyond 30 days we may need to revisit per contract clauses; we'll notify the customer before converting to a payable invoice.
Sam (Procurement): If they push back on waiting, the only other option is a temporary card charge, but enterprise procurement typically won't accept that. Recommend holding.
Ryan (SRE): unrelated note — saw a small spike in 5xxs from optima's API keys yesterday around 22:10 UTC. Might be separate; flagging in case their procurement pause coincides with test traffic.
Maria (Support): Thanks everyone. Logging the flow: CS-9821 -> proforma PF-1904827200-OPTIMA sent -> billing hold placed. Will close thread once PO arrives and invoice issued. :white_check_mark:
